member.name: T:Expedita.ErrorHandling.XEventLogger
member.summary: Provides access to Windows Event Viewer. Alternatively, runtime events can be logged to a text file.
member.remarks: Events are logged according configuration settings loaded from Windows Registry sub-key "{ProjectId}\Debug". The project identifier is obtained from the application configuration file (app.config or web.config). If not defined then the running process name is used. By default INFORMATION level is used. If parameter "EventLog Disabled" is set on configuration file then no message will be written to the Event Viewer.

The following entries should be set in order to obtain the expected results: Recipient - EventViewer OR File. If "EventViewer" is used then events are logged on the "Eventos Expedita" folder /// Level - 1 (ERROR), 2 (WARNING) or 3 (INFORMATION) FileName - name of the event log file. NOTE 1: Custom Event Viewer's folder/log "Eventos Expedita" is used. In order to use a different log then change static variable DEFAULT_FOLDER_NAME. NOTE 2: If a new Event Viewer's source is created for a different custom folder/log than the original then a Windows Registry refresh or machine restart is required.
